label: Queries
description: Discovers read-only Queries from effective file inventories and executes resolved implementations to retrieve data.

queryDescriptor.description: Frozen lightweight metadata for one discovered Query.

id.description: Query identifier derived from its path below the owning queries directory.

moduleId.description: Owning module ID, or xshell for a framework Query.

label.description: Authored Query label, or an empty string when omitted.

description.description: Authored Query description, or an empty string when omitted.

tags.description: Frozen authored Query tags in declaration order.

category.description: Effective Query category, defaulting to the owning module ID.

icon.description: Authored Query icon, or an empty string when omitted.

path.description: Normalized virtual path of the Query JavaScript file.

size.description: Physical Query file size in bytes.

queryDescriptorList.description: Frozen array of Query descriptors sorted by Query ID.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against ID, label, description, and tags.

id.description: Query identifier resolved through the query Loader.

args.description: Named arguments validated and ordered using the Query contract.

list.description: Synchronously lists Queries from effective framework and module file inventories without loading implementations.

getInfo.description: Synchronously gets one discovered Query descriptor by exact ID without loading its implementation.

returns.description: Frozen Query descriptor, or null when the ID is unknown.

run.description: Asynchronously resolves a Query, validates its arguments, executes it, and validates its result.

returns.description: The Query result as declared by its return contract.
